rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s or something’s visible looks and outward appearance.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 ngoi6 maau6 gei2 si1 man4

rows.note: Use this for the event of someone or something coming into sight or becoming visible.

example.english: As soon as he made an appearance, everyone went quiet.
example.traditional: 佢一出現，大家即刻靜晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 jin6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 zing6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when someone makes a public or social appearance rather than merely becoming visible.

example.english: They have not made an appearance at the office for a long time.
example.traditional: 佢好耐冇喺公司露面喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 noi6 mou5 hai2 gung1 si1 lau6 min6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone’s appearance before a court in legal proceedings.

example.english: The defendant has to make an appearance in court tomorrow.
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 ting4
